blocks.text: LOS ANGELES — Keyonte George scored nine of his 30 points in the fourth quarter, and the Utah Jazz improbably snapped the Los Angeles Lakers’ nine-game winning streak with a 109-97 victory in the NBA Wednesday night. Ace Bailey added 10 of his 19 points in the fourth quarter for the Jazz, who started their season 1-13 before beating both Los Angeles teams in the past two days. Luka Doncic scored 29 points and made nine turnovers while going 2 for 12 on 3-point attempts in the first embarrassing loss of the season for the Lakers, who had gone 9-0 in […]...
